apis.description:
Returns all LTI registrations in the specified account.
Includes registrations created in this account, those set to 'allow' from a
parent root account (like Site Admin) and 'on' for this account,
and those enabled 'on' at the parent root account level.

operations.summary: List LTI Registrations in an account
operations.notes:
Returns all LTI registrations in the specified account.
Includes registrations created in this account, those set to 'allow' from a
parent root account (like Site Admin) and 'on' for this account,
and those enabled 'on' at the parent root account level.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of registrations to return per page. Defaults to 15.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The field to sort by. Choices are: name, nickname, lti_version, installed,
installed_by, updated_by, updated, and on. Defaults to installed.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: The order to sort the given column by. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Array of additional data to include. Always includes [account_binding].

"account_binding":: the registration's binding to the given account
"configuration":: the registration's Canvas-style tool configuration, without any overlays applied.
"overlaid_configuration":: the registration's Canvas-style tool configuration, with all overlays applied.
"overlay":: the registration's admin-defined configuration overlay

apis.description: Enable or disable the specified LTI registration for the specified account. To enable an inherited registration (eg from Site Admin), pass the registration's global ID. Only allowed for root accounts. Specifics for Site Admin: "on" enables and locks the registration on for all root accounts. "off" disables and hides the registration for all root accounts. "allow" makes the registration visible to all root accounts, but accounts must bind it to use it. Specifics for centrally-managed/federated consortia: Child root accounts may only bind registrations created in the same account. For parent root account, binding also applies to all child root accounts.

operations.summary: Bind an LTI Registration to an Account
operations.notes: Enable or disable the specified LTI registration for the specified account. To enable an inherited registration (eg from Site Admin), pass the registration's global ID. Only allowed for root accounts. Specifics for Site Admin: "on" enables and locks the registration on for all root accounts. "off" disables and hides the registration for all root accounts. "allow" makes the registration visible to all root accounts, but accounts must bind it to use it. Specifics for centrally-managed/federated consortia: Child root accounts may only bind registrations created in the same account. For parent root account, binding also applies to all child root accounts.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.description: ID

parameters.description: The desired state for this registration/account binding. "allow" is only valid for Site Admin registrations.

apis.description:
This is a utility endpoint used by the Canvas Apps UI and may not serve general use cases.

Search for accounts and courses that match the search term on name, SIS id, or course code.
Returns bare-bones data about each account and course. Used to populate the search dropdowns
when managing LTI registration availability.

vendor.description: Tool-provided name of the tool vendor

account_id.description: The Canvas id of the account that owns this registration

internal_service.description: Flag indicating if registration is internally-owned

inherited.description: Flag indicating if registration is owned by this account, or inherited from Site Admin

lti_version.description: LTI version of the registration, either 1.1 or 1.3

dynamic_registration.description: Flag indicating if registration was created using LTI Dynamic Registration. Only present if lti_version is 1.3

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the registration's last update

created_by.description: The user that created this registration. Not always present. If a string, this registration was created by Instructure.

updated_by.description: The user that last updated this registration. Not always present. If a string, this registration was last updated by Instructure.
